caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing slope, shown open and viewed from an angle, resting on a plain, off-white background. The writing slope is rectangular with a hinged join along its midline, forming two slanted planes covered in a brown surface, possibly felt or leather. The wooden frame is reddish-brown with visible wood grain, and the front side includes a small brass handle on the right. The upper compartment of the writing slope is divided into multiple smaller rectangular sections, designed for holding writing implements or other small items. There are subtle metallic hinges and clasps visible on the sides of the writing slope. The artist's signature, "M. Goodman," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Writing Desk, Lap
